change: Baseline: grayscale + Gaussian blur + Otsu threshold + remove small blobs + fill holes
why: Simplest possible classical method; gives a reference score for every later trial
reason: Baseline, reference point for all later trials

change: Replace grayscale with Lab colour distance from the border-median background colour, then Otsu
why: T0 failed on bright eggs on bright backgrounds and on dark backlit eggs (20, 44) because it assumes egg is brighter than background
reason: Mean IoU fell 0.379 -> 0.359. White eggs on white bag/wall/cloth look like background in colour-distance, so the method selects dark corners and holes instead (IoU 0.00 on 30, 106, 104, 112, 111, 32, 6, 5)

change: T0 + keep only regions with area 2-40% of image, not touching the border, solidity >= 0.9
why: Dev Task 1 masks: eggs are 2.7-38% of the image, 1/111 touches the border, median solidity ~1.0; T0 failures are mostly large border-touching background regions
reason: Mean IoU fell 0.379 -> 0.217; method returned nothing for 62/88 images. Otsu merges the egg with border-touching background, so the border/size filter removes the egg too

change: Replace single Otsu threshold with a 24-level threshold sweep (bright and dark side); pick blobs by ellipse-fit IoU + boundary edge strength, with size/border rules and overlap removal
why: T2 showed Otsu merges the egg with the background; a single threshold cannot isolate it, but some threshold in a sweep may, and an ellipse fit can pick that one
reason: Mean IoU 0.379 -> 0.509 (+0.131), failures 61 -> 40. A threshold sweep with ellipse-fit + edge scoring isolates eggs that a single Otsu threshold merges with the background

change: T3 + extra candidates from Lab a, Lab b and HSV saturation (12 thresholds each, bright and dark side); scoring and filters unchanged
why: D2: with grey-level candidates only 60% of eggs have a candidate with IoU>=0.6; white eggs on white backgrounds may differ in colour channels even when brightness matches
reason: Mean IoU 0.509 -> 0.564 (+0.055), failures 40 -> 34, IoU==0 images 13 -> 8; oracle ceiling 0.638 -> 0.715. Lab a/b and saturation candidates separate some white eggs that grey-level cannot

change: T4 candidates and acceptance test unchanged; ranking = ellipse-fit + 0.5*edge + 0.5*mean brightness inside the blob
why: In 5 of T4's 8 worst images (125, 106, 104, 111, 123) a dark hole/shadow in the white bag outranks the white egg, although the egg is among the candidates (oracle)
reason: Mean IoU 0.564 -> 0.558, failures 34 -> 37. The output is the union of all accepted blobs, so reordering by brightness cannot remove a false blob; the white-bag eggs are not accepted at all (score < 0.9), so ranking was never their problem

change: T4 candidates and scoring unchanged; a candidate is accepted only if its mean brightness inside is >= 0.6
why: D3: 90% of the 191 accepted false blobs are darker than 0.55, while 90% of good-egg candidates are brighter than 0.70; brightness was used only for ordering in T5, which cannot remove blobs from the union
reason: Mean IoU 0.564 -> 0.590 (+0.026), median 0.571 -> 0.694, failures unchanged at 34. 18 images improved by >0.1, 5 got worse by >0.1. The gate removed dark false blobs but also zeroed some real eggs (44, 78): 11 images gave an empty output. Assumes pale eggs under normal lighting

change: T6 plus a fallback: if the output is empty, retry with brightness gate 0.3 and keep only the single best candidate
why: T6 left 11 empty outputs, and every image contains an egg; 78, 27, 44 and 20 are real eggs darker than the 0.6 gate
reason: Mean IoU 0.590 -> 0.598 (+0.007), failures 34 -> 33. Empty outputs 11 -> 4, but only image 78 recovered above 0.5 (0.64). The fallback picked a wrong blob in most other cases

change: T7 plus: replace each accepted blob with its filled fitted ellipse
why: Diagnostic on 160 and 50: T6 outputs are clean but partial (precision ~0.97, recall 0.39-0.45); eggs are near-elliptical (median ellipse fit 0.95)
reason: Mean IoU 0.598 -> 0.589 (-0.008), failures unchanged at 33. No image improved by >0.1, one got worse by >0.1 (12: -0.14). Ellipse completion did not recover 160 (0.44 -> 0.42) or 50 (0.39 -> 0.38)

change: T7 plus GrabCut per accepted blob (sure FG = eroded blob, ring 0.4*radius as probable BG, 10 iterations)
why: D4: no global-threshold candidate covers the egg in the failing images; partial blobs (104, 111, 149, 160, 50) exist inside the egg and can seed a colour-model refinement
reason: Mean IoU 0.598 -> 0.671 (+0.073), median 0.694 -> 0.769, failures 33 -> 21. 32 images improved by >0.1, none worsened by >0.1. GrabCut seeded from accepted blobs recovers partial eggs (160 0.44 -> 0.59, 50 0.39 -> 0.53). Does not help where the seed is wrong or missing: 104, 111, 149 stay at 0

why: Ring width is a hand-set GrabCut parameter; sweep to check sensitivity
reason: ring=0.2: mean IoU 0.6416 vs 0.6705 for ring=0.4 (-0.029), failures 24 vs 21. A narrow ring gives GrabCut too little background to model

why: Ring width is a hand-set GrabCut parameter; sweep to check sensitivity
reason: ring=0.6: mean IoU 0.6818 vs 0.6705 for ring=0.4 (+0.011), failures 18 vs 21. Wider ring is better; new base for later trials

change: T9 with ring=0.8 (best so far was 0.6)
why: Mean IoU kept rising from ring 0.2 to 0.6; check whether it peaks at 0.6 or keeps rising
reason: ring=0.8: mean IoU 0.6880 vs 0.6818 for ring=0.6 (+0.006), failures 18 vs 18. Gain is shrinking, so the sweep has nearly plateaued. Final ring value

change: T9 with ring=1.0 (best so far was 0.6)
why: Mean IoU kept rising from ring 0.2 to 0.6; check whether it peaks at 0.6 or keeps rising
reason: ring=1.0: mean IoU 0.6883 vs 0.6880 for ring=0.8 (+0.0003, below the 0.005 bar), failures 19 vs 18. Plateau reached; larger ring adds no benefit

change: T9d (ring=0.8) with acceptance threshold min_score lowered from 0.9 to 0.85
why: D4: 111 and 149 have a partial candidate with base score 0.88, just below 0.9; GrabCut may be able to refine a weaker seed
reason: min_score 0.9 -> 0.85: mean IoU 0.688 -> 0.698 (+0.010) but failures rose 18 -> 20, so the pre-set rule (mean +0.005 AND failures not higher) is not met. 111 (0.0 -> 0.98) and 149 (0.0 -> 0.76) recovered, but 7 images got worse by >0.1. In 28 and 130 precision fell (0.99 -> 0.29 and 0.93 -> 0.46) and predicted area grew 3-4x (28: 4.2% -> 14.5% vs GT 5.7%; 130: 12.7% -> 25.7% vs GT 11.8%), i.e. the lower threshold admitted an extra false blob next to an egg that was already found

change: T9d, plus: if nothing is accepted at score 0.9 (gate 0.6), retry once at score 0.85 with a single egg before the gate-0.3 fallback
why: T10 recovered 111 and 149 but added a false blob in 28 and 130, where an egg was already accepted at 0.9; applying 0.85 only to images with an empty output should keep the gain and avoid the loss
reason: T9d plus a single-egg retry at accept score 0.85 only when the 0.9 pass is empty: mean IoU 0.688 -> 0.719 (+0.031), median 0.779 -> 0.800, failures 18 -> 16. 5 images improved by >0.1 (111: 0.0 -> 0.98, 149: 0.0 -> 0.76, 28: 0.73 -> 0.99), none got worse by >0.1 (worst: 37, -0.07). Keeps the T10 gains without its extra false blobs. 5 and 104 stay at 0.0. Sanity check with min_score_lo=0.9 gave 0.6892 against 0.6880 for T9d, a small difference attributed to GrabCut random initialisation

change: Frozen pipeline = T11 with the GrabCut random seed fixed (cv2.setRNGSeed(0) before each image); a reproducibility re-run, not a tuning trial
why: GrabCut uses random initialisation, so repeated runs differ slightly (T9d 0.6880 against 0.6892 on re-run); the seed must be fixed before the single eval run so the reported numbers can be reproduced
reason: Frozen final pipeline with fixed seed. No parameter was changed after T11
